name: tend-yc-demo
description: TEND YC demo video (Remotion). Not part of the app build.

scripts.final: remotion render TendDemo out/render_v3.mp4 --crf=14 --x264-preset=slow --audio-bitrate=256k && ffmpeg -y -i out/render_v3.mp4 -c copy -movflags +faststart out/TEND_YC_DEMO_FINAL_V3.mp4 && rm out/render_v3.mp4
